inspiration.source_location: Minimized from sql/mysql/Positive-Technologies/examples/dml_select.sql: nested binary-to-UTF-8 conversion around LEFT
inspiration.observed_pattern: A scalar expression slices a binary conversion by byte count and converts the result back to UTF-8 text.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed three-character UTF-8 label and a six-byte LEFT slice, retaining only nested binary conversion, byte slicing, UTF-8 conversion, and hexadecimal observability.

fixture_notes: The first two three-byte UTF-8 characters must remain after the six-byte binary slice; the third character must be absent.
determinism_notes: The label and byte length are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT CONVERT(LEFT(CONVERT('霜時計' USING binary), 6) USING utf8mb4) AS clipped_label, HEX(CONVERT(LEFT(CONVERT('霜時計' USING binary), 6) USING utf8mb4)) AS clipped_hex
